svg.title: The four-phase agent loop
svg.desc: The agent loop runs perceive, think, act, and remember in sequence and returns to perceive until the task is complete or a stop condition ends the run. Infinite loops start in act; context exhaustion and lost tool results start in remember.

text.tspan: Pick a tool and its arguments

g.text: AGENT LOOP · REPEATS UNTIL A STOP CONDITION

svg.text: Infinite loops start here. Set an explicit iteration budget and test it.
Context exhaustion and lost tool results start here, not in perceive.
